description: Patterns that flag a reviewer answer which talks about planted or test errors instead of the work (SPEC 12.1 step 5, 12.2). A hit makes the attempt invalid; its findings still count, UNLESS the engine can show that the matched text comes from the reviewed material or from a primary source output (a verbatim quote with context, a search term that the source output really contains, or - only for patterns marked quotableTerm - a whole word that the material itself uses; see lib/material/meta-quote.mjs). Every regex is compiled with the flags shown plus 'g' and 'u'.

patterns.why: says an error was inserted on purpose
